threat_event: Ransomware encrypts TOS servers, gate servers and operations workstations at T1 to T6
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TOS reachable from the integration hub; 14 EDI adapter service accounts with static passwords
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; immutable backups; quarterly restore tests
treatment_plan: Certificates for EDI adapters; isolate hub flows (GR-01); tabletop with FSOs

threat_event: Ransomware at a Gulf terminal spreads from IT to crane and yard OT on the flat network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat IT and OT networks at T7 to T9; always-on vendor access; no SIEM visibility
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-T1L; SYS-T3 and SYS-T4 at T7 to T9
treatment_plan: Interim IT/OT firewall at each Gulf terminal by 2026-12-31; migration to standard OT zones by 2027-06-30

threat_event: An attacker uses the always-on crane vendor remote access at T7 to T9
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor cellular modems with shared accounts, no MFA and no session logging
treatment_plan: Disconnect modems; route vendor access through the group jump host

threat_event: Legacy TOS backups at the Gulf terminals are destroyed or too old to meet the RPO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly backups on local disk only; domain-joined; no immutable or offsite copy
treatment_plan: Offsite immutable copy in the provider B vault by 2026-12-31; quarterly restore test

threat_event: An intrusion at a Gulf terminal goes undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Network and TOS logs local only; not in the SIEM
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-T1L; SYS-T4 at T7 to T9
treatment_plan: Forward Gulf network and TOS logs to the SIEM by 2026-12-31

threat_event: Freight Trading staff use terminal data about competing importers
threat_source: Insider (affiliate staff) through an over-broad role
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group logistics role shows every customer's cargo, vessel and appointment data at T1 to T6
treatment_plan: Remove the role by 2026-11-30; cargo-owner view of own shipments; access log review for the last 12 months

threat_event: Appointment rules at T3 and T5 give the trading affiliate's truckers reserved slots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reserved slots with no documented operational reason
treatment_plan: Remove or document and offer equivalent terms to all; legal review
owner: Marine Terminals director of customer services

threat_event: Cybersecurity Plans for T7 to T9 are late or disapproved
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No alternate CySOs or draft Plans for T7 to T9
treatment_plan: Designate alternates by 2026-10-31; draft Plans by 2027-02-28

threat_event: Untrained longshore workers using OT and VMTs miss or cause a cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 58% of longshore workers trained by the 2026-01-12 deadline; monitoring of untrained workers not recorded
treatment_plan: Training at hiring halls with the halls' agreement; record supervision of untrained workers; target 95% by 2026-12-31

threat_event: OT operators do not recognize OT-specific attacks or unsafe equipment behavior
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT-specific training only at T5
treatment_plan: Roll out the T5 OT course to all terminals

threat_event: The optimization service sends an unsafe or wrong ASC job sequence at T5
threat_source: Model or integration error; manipulated input
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic sequencing since 2026-03 without safety case, impact analysis or AI council approval
existing_controls: ASC safety interlocks in the equipment control system
treatment_plan: Return to advisory mode; safety case; AI council review (P10)

threat_event: A known exploited vulnerability in OT at T1 to T6 is used before it is fixed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 11 OT KEVs past due without documented compensating controls
treatment_plan: Patch or document compensating controls for each OT KEV within 30 days

threat_event: The T5 equipment control system cannot be restored and the automated stack stays down for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly backup; restore never tested; no manual mode for ASCs
treatment_plan: Restore test with the vendor during a no-vessel window by 2026-12-15

threat_event: False customs release or hold status lets a held container leave the gate
threat_source: Attacker or partner error in the customs status feed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single customs data exchange service; status trusted when well-formed
existing_controls: Message signing; hold override needs a second approver
treatment_plan: Daily reconciliation of releases against the customs data exchange portal

threat_event: Criminals use stolen pickup numbers or appointments to steal containers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Appointment and release data visible to many trucker users
treatment_plan: Bind pickups to the booked trucking company and plate
owner: Marine Terminals director of customer services

threat_event: Credential stuffing against the customer portal takes over trucker or cargo owner accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for trucker users
existing_controls: WAF; bot protection; MFA for cargo owner administrators
treatment_plan: MFA for all portal users by 2027-03-31
owner: Marine Terminals director of customer services

threat_event: Hurricane damages a terminal's gate complex and server rooms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gate servers on site; Gulf TOS servers on site
existing_controls: Hurricane plans; cloud TOS at T1 to T6
treatment_plan: Covered by GR-11 and GR-14

threat_event: PACS or TWIC readers fail or are tampered with
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PACS servers per terminal; reader firmware updates manual
treatment_plan: Add PACS servers to the OT inventory and patch cycle

threat_event: A clerk or superintendent changes container status to aid theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Status changes logged but reviewed only for hold overrides
existing_controls: Hold override second approval; daily report
treatment_plan: Add analytics for unusual status changes

threat_event: A malicious update to the commercial TOS software reaches production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor updates applied after staging tests
treatment_plan: Vendor secure development attestation at renewal

threat_event: A terminal fails to report a cyber incident immediately to the FBI, CISA and the Captain of the Port
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reporting procedures differ by terminal; Gulf procedures not updated
treatment_plan: One division reporting procedure with the group matrix (P08)

threat_event: Unauthorized media or laptops are connected to crane and ASC HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Open USB ports on 4 ASC maintenance HMIs at T5; technicians use own laptops at some sites
treatment_plan: Block ports; group-issued maintenance laptops

threat_event: Responders cannot locate hazardous cargo at a Gulf terminal during an outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dangerous cargo list only in the legacy TOS at T7 to T9
existing_controls: Printed lists at T1 to T6
treatment_plan: Printed list at each shift change at T7 to T9 from 2026-10-01

threat_event: An attacker uses default vendor passwords on OCR controllers or ASC maintenance HMIs at T5
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords found in P07 on 2 OCR portal controllers and 4 ASC maintenance HMIs (2026-08-12)
treatment_plan: Change passwords by 2026-09-30; sweep all terminals for defaults by 2026-11-30

threat_event: Crane vendor remote sessions at T1 to T6 are abused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sessions through the group jump host with MFA, approval and recording
treatment_plan: Accepted with current controls

threat_event: Provider A outage stops the TOS at T1 to T6
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single primary region
treatment_plan: Covered by GR-12

threat_event: Carrier messages sent by plain FTP are intercepted or altered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 carriers on unencrypted FTP into SYS-G4
treatment_plan: Move both carriers to SFTP or AS2 by 2026-12-31

threat_event: A port community system compromise sends false vessel or gate status
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Port community systems trusted for schedules
treatment_plan: Accepted; planners confirm schedule changes with carriers

threat_event: Billing data is altered to defraud customers or the terminal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rate changes need a second approver
treatment_plan: Accepted

threat_event: Draft Cybersecurity Plans or network maps are shared beyond need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drafts held on a general project site
treatment_plan: Covered by GR-18

threat_event: Migration of the Gulf terminals introduces misconfiguration or data loss
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large migration in 2027
treatment_plan: Cutover rehearsals per terminal; rollback plan

threat_event: GNSS jamming or spoofing disrupts crane and yard equipment positioning
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some RTG and tractor positioning uses satellite signals
treatment_plan: Accepted; monitor Coast Guard notices
